Meta.title: LumiClaw Presence | Delivery Foundation
Meta.description: An evidence-bound delivery foundation for global brand operations.

Shell.footer: A preview does not mean an account is connected, an artifact is approved, or a platform action occurred.

campaigns.title: Turn one business objective into reviewable coordinated action.
campaigns.summary: This surface will summarize real campaigns, prior outcomes, and one next step. M0 verifies navigation, state language, and delivery boundaries only.
campaigns.basis: Current basis: SDD-000, pinned dependencies, and public architecture
campaigns.next: Verify the M0 foundation; the Coordinator creates M1 only after acceptance.

setup.title: See facts, permissions, and material gaps first.
setup.summary: Future Setup work will place Identity, Product, Market, AccountMandate, and Claim–Evidence in one readiness view.
setup.basis: Current basis: public Claim and AccountMandate architecture
setup.next: Do not upload real material; wait for M1 domain and privacy gates.

mission.title: One factual core, four platform-native expressions.
mission.summary: The three-column Composer baseline relates ActivationUnit, editable fields, and approximate previews. It is not Agent execution or account-connection evidence.
mission.status: ADAPTER CONTRACT ONLY · no Agent turn
mission.basis: Current basis: six-role topology contract and four planned previews
mission.next: Review the information hierarchy and honest capability labels; execute nothing externally.

review.title: Approve an exact revision, never an ambiguous “send it”.
review.summary: This area will show Revision, Audit, OwnerDecision, Grant, and Receipt. M0 creates no approval or execution credential.
review.status: BLOCKED BY DESIGN · no approvable Revision
review.basis: Current basis: Producer/Auditor separation and short-lived single-use Grant rules
review.next: Review state copy only; do not provide platform tokens or attempt publication.

learn.title: Bring real responses into the next round without silently rewriting truth.
learn.summary: Future Interaction, Outcome, Disposition, and LearningProposal objects require provenance, scope, and an Owner decision.
learn.basis: Current basis: scoped learning and no silent mutation rules
learn.next: Confirm the empty state never presents a fixture as customer feedback or a business result.

Mission.disclaimer: Approximate preview; native rendering may change.
